Demo37 Mint's ear salon (the one live stream, new form) — prompts for the layered art (DEMO_DESIGN_GUIDE §6) → project/web_prompts.json
for tools/openai/images.py. Reference: her stream art (Demo14 mint_live → assets/art/web/d14_mint_live.jpg). The first pose (mint_greet)
becomes the character reference. Poses on chroma green — she has mint-GREEN hair, so the screen is chroma MAGENTA (#FF00FF) here and the
build uses "matte": "magenta" (build_stage). Mouth / blink variants: masked edits from project/face_points.json. Run: python3 scripts/prompts.py

bg_salon.prompt:
Image 1 is the ART STYLE reference only (do not draw her or her room). Same soft cel-animation style, thin coloured lineart, flat colours. Background plate only, NO people.

Her little 'ear salon' live-stream set at night, seen from the head of a cushioned reclining chair (first person, the viewer lies back slightly, eye level a little low): a white towel warmer with a small green light and a tiny steam kettle on a shelf on the left, a warm paper lamp, glass jars of cotton swabs and bamboo ear picks, a small potted mint plant, sheer curtains with a teal aquarium-like night glow on the right, fairy lights, a soft rug. The centre of the picture is open (a person will be placed there later, seated beside the chair).

Empty scene, no people. Wide 16:9 game scene. No text, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI, no readable writing anywhere.

mint_greet.prompt:
Image 1 is the CHARACTER and STYLE reference: draw this exact young woman (face, eyes, hair, braid, star clip).

Art style EXACTLY like image 1: soft modern cel animation, thin coloured lineart (dark teal-grey instead of black), flat colours with one soft-edged but still flat shadow tone, a calm night palette. Hand-drawn feel, NOT glossy, no bloom. Realistic adult proportions (not chibi), 7 heads tall.

Mint, 20: the exact young woman from image 1 — long silky mint-green hair fading to white at the tips, a thin low side braid, sleepy pale aqua eyes, a small star hair clip; an oversized white cable-knit cardigan over a pale blue camisole, and tonight a small mint salon apron over it.

She sits just beside the chair, centre, from the waist up, leaning a little toward the viewer, one hand raised in a small sleepy wave by her cheek, a soft drowsy smile, eyes half-lidded but open. Mouth CLOSED.

Lighting on her: a soft warm lamp from the upper left and a cool teal glow from the right, calm night light.

Plain flat CHROMA-KEY MAGENTA background (#FF00FF), one even colour, completely empty: no scenery, no chair, no floor line, no shadow and no gradient on the background, no magenta or pink anywhere on her or her props.

Wide 16:9 game scene. No text, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI, no readable writing anywhere.

mint_greet_talk.prompt: Edit this exact image. Keep EVERYTHING identical — same pose, hands, framing, size, position, hair strands, clothes, colours, lighting and background — and change ONLY her mouth: slightly open as if whispering softly, a small natural opening, no teeth showing. Do not move, zoom or crop the picture.

mint_greet_blink.prompt: Edit this exact image. Keep EVERYTHING identical — same pose, hands, framing, size, position, hair strands, clothes, colours, lighting and background — and change ONLY BOTH of her eyes: FULLY closed in a natural soft blink (upper eyelids all the way down on both eyes, lashes visible, no iris showing); her bangs stay exactly as they are. Do not move, zoom or crop the picture.
